app_store.name: TalkFlow: Live Translator
app_store.subtitle: Bilingual Calls & Meetings
app_store.promotional_text: Break language barriers instantly. Speak in your language, be heard in theirs with sub-second real-time speech translation and video meetings.
app_store.description:
TalkFlow enables natural real-time speech translation and multilingual video meetings across 50+ languages.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-Time Voice: Speak naturally and hear instant translated speech with sub-second latency.
- In-Browser Meetings: Create video conference links where guests pick their language and join without downloading extra apps.
- Layout-Preserving Documents: Translate PDFs and office files while keeping tables and formatting intact.
- Professional Writing: Polish grammar, adjust tone, and translate documents with custom brand glossaries.
- Transcript Export: Download timestamped subtitles in SRT and WebVTT formats for call recordings.
app_store.whats_new: Zero-login guest join links and enhanced audio streaming performance.
